item.stem:
The diagram shows trapezium $ABCD$ with $AB\parallel DC$ and equal non-parallel sides $AD=BC$. Diya studies whether the base angles are equal.

Which two claims are correct?

options.A: The trapezium has equal base angles because it is labelled $ABCD$.
options.D: The non-parallel sides are equal because the base angles are already equal.
